label: Recipe Book
notes: Its three slots are the platform's widest: chat, vision AND image. The image slot is why this rail's modelstate.py copy diverges from the others — a media-worker backend (flux-schnell / sdxl-turbo) is not an Ollama model and never appears in /v1/models, so resolving it the normal way reported MISSING forever on a feature that works. Image slots are resolved against the broker's media block instead.

For the icon slot, 'cold' is the healthy steady state, not a warning: the broker's media worker is a short-lived subprocess that exits to reclaim VRAM after every render, so an image backend is green only DURING a render. The chip tooltip says so.

GET /api/models now serves the chip contract like every other rail's. It previously returned the broker's installed-model inventory — a name collision with the chip route that meant something completely different. Nothing consumed it, so the inventory moved to /api/broker/models.

Holds the one sanctioned exception to the @role rule: RECIPE_BOOK_LLM_MODEL in broker.py is a module-level fallback with no role of its own. It is not a manifest slot because nothing configures it per-deployment.
